name: Perseverance sample list
product: Mars Rock Samples table (sample number, name, rock, location, rock type, sol sealed)
notes: 30 samples as published by NASA. Each is placed at the rover's localised stop (JPL MMGIS waypoints) on the sol it was taken. NASA lists the sol a tube was sealed; the coring sol is read from the raw images feed (the last sol up to sealing with a full set of CacheCam frames), because a few tubes were sealed later and elsewhere. NASA gives no sealing sol yet for samples 29 and 30 (Bell Island, Gallants): their sols come from the photo captions on the same page (sols 1497 and 1551) and the CacheCam frames around them. The campaign is derived from NASA's sampling location.
